newsitem.title: PERU: Peru names lawyer as first Women's Minister.
newsitem.headline: Peru names lawyer as first Women's Minister.

text.p: The Peruvian government named Tuesday 42-year-old lawyer Miriam Esperanza Schenone Ordinola to head the newly created ministry for women's promotion and human development.
Schenone, a former justice vice minister, will be sworn in by President Alberto Fujimori later Tuesday at 1800 local time (2300 GMT), officials said.
The government also announced the resignation of Industry, Tourism and Commercial Integration Minister Liliana Canale Novella, who will be replaced by businessman Gustavo Caillaux.
Officials did not explain why Canale had resigned from the low-profile cabinet post.
Caillaux was also set to be sworn in later Tuesday.
